snippet.title: Amon Amarth - Eight Legs of Thunder (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Pre-order our new album "The Allfather Awakens" out October 2 at https://amonamarth.com
Listen / Share / Playlist “Eight Legs of Thunder” /  https://lnk.to/EightLegsOfThunder

"With 'Eight Legs Of Thunder', together with the band, we wanted to break the traditional metal music video mold once again. We fused the raw, dusty vibe of a modern western with the epic, dark mythology of Odin’s eight-legged steed. It’s a high-octane, cinematic ride packed with cowboy tension, raw action, and a touch of dark humor. We didn’t just want to make a music video—we wanted to deliver a visual knockout that would resound across the entire industry” Dariusz Szermanowicz - The Director

EIGHT LEGS OF THUNDER
It is time
My trusted steed
Together we ride
Together we bleed
End is nigh
So ride like the wind
Blazing the sky
Facing death with a grin

Lead the way
To glory! My friend
You must never sway
Fight ‘til the end
The battle stands
On Vigrid's field
Though death is at hand
We will never yield

Eight legs of thunder
Riding to war
Tear them asunder
It's time to settle the score
Eight legs of thunder
An unstoppable force
Riding to plunder
They shall die by my sword

So lead the way
To downfall my friend
To end of days
We shall not relent
By my command
We ride out to war
One final stand
Hear our battle cries roar

It's the end
The Völva foretold
Darkness descends
And men's courage will fold
But true the hearts
Of warriors of old
Einherjer charge
As Ragnarök unfolds

Eight legs of thunder
Riding to war
Tear them asunder
It's time to settle the score
Eight legs of thunder
An unstoppable force
Riding to plunder
They shall die by my sword

Eight legs of thunder
Like the waves of the tide
We'll pull them down under
A storm that doesn't subside
Eight legs of thunder
Though I know I shall die
My eight-legged wonder
To ruin! To ruin we ride!

Eight legs of thunder
As Yggdrasil burns
My eight-legged wonder
It's too late for us to turn
Eight legs of thunder
When my body is torn
By Fenris asunder
Sleipner carry me home
========

“СЕРЕНАДА”

Ще дойда с една китара пред дома ти,
съседите ти нека мислят, че не съм добре.
И ще крещя с цяло гърло да ме чуеш:
"Обичам те, обичам те!"

И нека кой каквото ще да ми разправя,
в сърцето друга няма никога да имам аз.
Ако още ме обичаш, чакам те пред вас.


Една червена роза нося си със мене
и не е много, но давам ти я от сърце.
На цяла София разказал съм за тебе,
сърце мое, сърце мое.

Както Ромео е обичал Жулиета,
така за тебе да умра готов съм аз.
Ако още ме обичаш, чакам те пред вас.


Любимата ти песен цяла нощ ще свиря.
Нека ме сочат и да ми се смеят всичките,
но само който е обичал, ме разбира
какво ми е, какво ми е.

И нека кой каквото ще да ми разправя,
в сърцето друга няма никога да имам аз.
Ако още ме обичаш, чакам те пред вас.


И знам, че някой ден, дори да спра да дишам,
с тебе и смъртта не може да ни раздели.
Съдбата ми е само тебе да обичам
завинаги, завинаги.

И нека кой каквото ще да ми разправя,
дори да бъда с друга, ти да бъдеш с някой друг,
на сърцето ми ще пише: "Тя остана тук."

snippet.title: ARK Astraeos 'Heaven & Abyss' Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Embark on an epic ARK odyssey with Astraeos! Explore this vast, breathtaking world, steeped in Greek mythology, where majestic mountain ridges and marble cliffs meet pristine white sand beaches and a paradise of cherry blossoms. Spanning over 264 square kilometers, Astraeos is brimming with stunning scenery, ancient ruins, and sacred temples. 

That odyssey now reaches its final chapter with Astraeos 1.0 and its most ambitious expansion yet: Heaven and the Abyss. A realm of divine trials fit for the pantheon, from floating island peaks to dark abyssal trenches, command ancient warships across violent seas and prove your worth against the legendary horrors of myth.

Helianthos: A bright, lush island of towering mountain ridges, open flower-filled plains, peaceful creatures, and flying islands suspended high above the landscape.

Abyssanthos: A fog-shrouded deep-sea expanse with enormous underwater air bubbles supporting a mythical underwater city, providing space for base-building far beneath the surface.

The Trireme: The ocean is no longer a passive boundary. Dynamic, rolling wave mechanics and new weather events transform the seas into a restless, shifting frontier, giving the new ancient Trireme warship the perfect arena for rough-water navigation.

The Boaratos: A massive, fiercely aggressive, and scorching new boar found exclusively on Astraeos.

Two Kraken Ascension Boss Fights: Confront the merciless leviathan in two distinct encounters, one underwater and another at the surface.

New Minibosses: Face the immense Colossus and the ferocious Kroaratos.

New Apex Rewards and Cosmetics: Claim Astral Souls as a powerful new Apex drop alongside the Agamemnon Helmet, Trireme Chair, Boaratos Spartan Saddle, Divine Sword, Divine Spear, and Divine Shield.


But That's Not All - More Adventures Await Across ARK!

The horizons of ARK: Survival Ascended continue to expand with brand-new creatures, naval warfare, and coastal raids!

Available now on ARK: Survival Ascended:

Concavenator: This ruthless pack hunter turns the desert into a lethal playground as they swim beneath the dunes ambushing prey with aerial attacks and blinding sand clouds!
Available now with ARK: Tides of Fortune

The Galleon: Take the helm of the majestic Galleon, the ultimate naval titan designed for extensive fortress-style base building and a devastating battery of cannons built for catastrophic broadside barrages!

Land Outposts: Scour coastal shores for land-based pirate camps across Genesis 1's oceanic islands, eliminate the defending rogues, and plunder their buried treasure!

snippet.title: Miley Cyrus & Dolly Parton Perform “Wrecking Ball” / “I Will Always Love You” | Full Performance
snippet.description:
Remembering Dolly Parton, the Queen of Country Music, through one of her most unforgettable performances with goddaughter Miley Cyrus. 🤍

During Miley’s New Year’s Eve Party, Miley and Dolly shared the stage for several songs throughout the night, including “Jolene,” “I Love Rock ’n’ Roll” and “Walkin’ After Midnight.”

One of the most emotional moments came when they performed Miley’s “Wrecking Ball” before transitioning into Dolly’s “I Will Always Love You.”

Written and originally recorded by Dolly in the 1970s, “I Will Always Love You” became one of the defining songs of her career and later reached another generation through Whitney Houston’s iconic recording.

Hearing Miley sing the song alongside the woman who wrote it made the performance feel especially powerful, bringing together two generations of music history and the close personal bond they shared.

Following Dolly Parton’s passing at age 80, moments like this carry an entirely new weight.

Rest in peace, Dolly. Your songs, songwriting and influence will live forever. 🤍

snippet.title: The Division 2: Red Horizon - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Agents, the Cleaners have arrived in Washington D.C.
 
For the first time, the notorious faction has crossed into the capital, searching for the resources needed to produce their signature Purple Flame. Fight fire with fire through new Burn-focused gameplay and open-world encounters as you push back against a growing Red Horizon.
 
This season expands the Dark Zone experience with the new Blackout Dark Zone, an uncapped PvP environment where your full build power, including Prototype Gear, can be unleashed. Plus, the fan-favorite Toxic Dark Zone joins the permanent rotation, offering a unique PvE-focused take on the Dark Zone.
 
Take on new Classified Assignments, unlock new gear, and progress through a brand-new Season Pass packed with cosmetics, gear, and more. With limited-time events, new challenges, and additional rewards arriving throughout the season, there's always a new battle waiting on the horizon.
 
The Division 2: Red Horizon launches on August 27.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.
